ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels across the central surfaces and 15% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the perimeter and notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity contiguous band along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; a prominent low-intensity triangular patch at the central peduncle insertion point; sparse, isolated dark focal spots on the medial left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 units; extreme jagged edge morphology at both the left and right distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curvature tapering to sharp lateral tips; leading edge exhibits a linear diagonal trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark, roughly circular pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct diagonal low-intensity linear disruption on the medial portion of the left lobe; multiple short vertical linear marks visible near the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe irregular truncation and low-intensity pixel density at the right distal tip, indicating significant tissue loss or concentrated encrustation.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated vertical dark stripe originating at the notch base and extending into the lower central region of the left lobe.
